senses.gloss: ch. same, to walk with legs wide apart, waddle.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 20:8">Targ. II Sam. XX, 8</cite> (h. text <he>ותפל</he>!), v. <cite ref="Q01304"><he>פְּסִיעַ</he></cite>.—
Pes. 111ᵇ האי מאן דפ׳ אדיקלא (Ms. M. דמִיפְּסַע Ithpe.) he who steps over a (young) date palm.—V. פְּצֵי.

<cite ref="Yevamot 105b:6">Yeb. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>אגב יוקריה הוה מְפַסַּע ואזיל</he> on account of his heavy build he stepped in and walked (through the assembled students, making the impression of haughtiness), v. preced.—Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ bot. <he>והוה … מְפַסַּע וכ׳</he> and R. J. stepped upon the graves.
